'''Forig Thull''' was an infamous [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Thull was one of the few owners of a [[DZ 17X Nemesis]] battle armor.<ref name="Outlaw Battle Armor">{{JournalCite|3|Outlaw Battle Armor}}</ref>
